text.en: Soak dried chickpeas before cooking them.
text.de: Getrocknete Kichererbsen vor dem Kochen einweichen.

why.en: The tough seed coat makes legumes slow to cook; soaking speeds it up.
why.de: Die harte Samenschale macht Hülsenfrüchte langsam gar; Einweichen beschleunigt das.

sources.title: Food Preparation Lab Manual (Beirman and Gilbert)
sources.place: chapter 5 Cereals vs. Legumes, section 5.1 Cereal and Legume Introduction
sources.sentence: Legumes need to be soaked and often pressure-cooked due to a tough seed coat, higher protein content, and larger particle size.

sources.title: Food Preparation Lab Manual (Beirman and Gilbert)
sources.place: chapter 5 Cereals vs. Legumes, section 5.1 Cereal and Legume Introduction
sources.sentence: Two ways to speed the cooking of legumes are soaking and pressure cooking.
